scope: Scoped native selected-multiline suggestion raw-source integrity, exact posting/application and cold restart; not full GitLab or overall parity.
finding: Pinned Rapid Diffs encodes literal backslash-n as U+E000, colliding with genuine source U+E000. Six actual contexts include a real two-line drag selection.
repair: Native insertion fetches and validates raw repository lines, preserves their original characters, and uses the existing mapped async insertion queue. Displayed sentinels are never reversed or stripped.

verification.frontend: passed with two existing warnings; two Rspack threads
verification.pureNode: No DOM/shim; cancellation, stale source/context/permissions, mapped unrelated edits, overlap refusal, one-step undo, CRLF, raw Unicode and JSON-like text covered.
verification.host: Real Vue/Axios raw text handling, duplicate button disable, handoff blocking, changed context and unmount abort verified.
liveChecks: Real selected multiline diff context inserts exact raw backslash-n and genuine U+E000 as distinct original source values.
Replacement plus expanded range apply and undo/redo atomically in the actual native menu.
Ctrl+Enter leaves source without triggering GitLab quick submit; subsequent prose remains in the draft.
Normal GitLab submission persists exact native suggestion source, offsets and prose via the authenticated discussions API.
GitLab Apply suggestion creates a real source-branch commit containing exactly the intended replacement and untouched remaining file lines.
verification.visualReview: Inspected actual source/range modal, native draft, posted reader, Applied overview and cold-restart screenshots.

remaining: Actual unchanged/context-line and broader legacy source transport variants
